methodologyNotes: Covers handheld random-orbit sanders: powered sanders that spin a round backing pad while it also oscillates on an offset bearing, sold as a standalone tool at a published US price. Includes corded and cordless (bare-tool or kit) palm and dual-mode random-orbit sanders. Excludes fixed-base disc sanders, belt sanders, sheet/finishing (quarter-sheet) sanders, detail/mouse sanders, and drywall sanders. Price is typical US MSRP or street price, USD, for the configuration named (bare tool or kit as stated in priceNote). powerSource is an enum: 'corded' or 'cordless'. padDiameterIn is the sanding pad/disc diameter in inches (typically 5 or 6). orbitDiameterMm is the orbit (oscillation) diameter in millimeters; left null when a maker publishes only an orbit radius. oscillationsPerMinuteMax is the maximum no-load orbits/oscillations per minute (OPM). variableSpeed is a boolean for stepped or stepless speed control. amperage is the corded motor's rated amps (null for cordless). voltage is the cordless battery platform voltage in volts (null for corded). dustCollectionType is an enum describing onboard collection: 'bag', 'canister', 'vacuum-port' (dust port for a hose only), or 'bag-and-port' (included bag plus a hose-ready port). weightLbs is the bare-tool weight in pounds. vibrationMs2 is the declared hand-arm vibration emission in m/s^2. noiseLevelDb is the declared sound-pressure level in dB(A). Any spec not stated verbatim on a fetched manufacturer or retailer page is left null.

Neither page disclosed vibration (m/s^2) or sound-pressure (dB(A)) figures and amperage was not stated (only 400 W / 120 VAC), so those specs are left null; the Festool spec table's anomalous 3.53 lb (1.5 kg) weight was set aside in favor of the consistently corroborated 1.2 kg (2.6 lb) bare-tool weight.
